'''Noloh Gunga Fuel Station''' was a meeting place for independent trawlers in [[The Three Jetties]] District of [[Bartyn's Landing]], a town in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. It was physically between two of the three jetties. It was also the site of [[Noloh Gunga Bongoform]], a local factory not belonging to the [[Bartyn family]].

The station was active in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].
